title: Night Shift Store | Official Announcement Trailer
author: Flashy-Childhood4751
selftext:
Hey everyone!

We're a two-person indie team working on Nightshift Store, a casual convenience store simulator we've been developing for around 7–8 months.

We wanted to make something a little less repetitive than traditional store sims, with shorter shifts, random events, and a more relaxed gameplay loop.

As for AI, we've used it in different parts of development. On the art side, I've used AI to help create some product packaging designs, textures and UI, which I then adapted and integrated into the game. I also handle the 3D modeling and environments by hand.

My teammate handles the programming and gameplay and UI systems, using AI coding tools to help with implementation and development.

So AI has been part of our workflow, but we've also put a lot of our own work into designing, building, and refining the game over the past several months.

We recently uploaded our first playable build to itch.io. It's free to try, and we'd love to hear what you think!

[https://moorgames.itch.io/night-shift-store](https://moorgames.itch.io/night-shift-store)
